user_flow.default_volume: Use explicit board/system policy; the single SD system profile needs no storage choice
user_flow.optional_storage_setting: Select a volume only; managed directories remain fixed
user_flow.unavailable_or_full: Request media insertion, cleanup or another qualified volume; never request an arbitrary directory

path_scope: Paths are relative to a selected volume root, not Guest paths or native mount points

telemetry.live_frame_and_memory_sampling: Bounded memory snapshots; no filesystem traversal
telemetry.capacity_scans: Background cached snapshots with sample time; never triggered by each frame or Guest callback
telemetry.install_admission: Revalidate through reservation authority; stale display capacity is not allocation authority

app_key.authority: Always compare the full installed lineage-root and app-id; display name is not identity

identifiers.system_id: Nonzero random bytes[16]; identity of the selected system instance, stored in its control store
identifiers.store_id: Nonzero random bytes[16], bound to SystemId and VolumeId; lowercase hexadecimal directory component
identifiers.release_id: Nonzero random bytes[16]; immutable package generation; never reused
identifiers.data_id: Nonzero random bytes[16]; persistent data instance; independent of release_id
identifiers.resource_id: Nonzero random bytes[16]; immutable system-resource generation
identifiers.operation_id: Nonzero random bytes[16]; control-store-scoped operation identity
identifiers.collision_rule: Refuse or regenerate on conflict; never adopt or overwrite by matching directory name alone

system_profiles.name: internal-system
system_profiles.application_targets: Any qualified internal or removable volume

system_profiles.name: removable-system
system_profiles.control_location: Selected qualified SD or other supported removable system volume
system_profiles.application_targets: Same system volume or another qualified volume

system_root.authority: Selected SystemRoot control store is authoritative; placement is not discovered by package-directory scans
system_root.selection: Explicit board device/partition policy or recovery-UI choice; ambiguity never resolved by label, scan order or timestamp
system_root.without_internal_persistent_anchor: Cannot authenticate previous system-card identity or remember a dynamic boot choice; make no such guarantee
system_root.missing_corrupt_or_read_only: Use firmware recovery; never format automatically or create replacement private state
system_root.removal: Stop all dependent instances; invalidate work and font access; drain safely or reset under watchdog; select another system only after restart in the first profile
system_root.migration: Explicit maintenance copy with all writers stopped; boot-medium selection is separate and not claimed atomic across two removable cards

placement.shared_media_independent: Other explicitly granted shared directories; automatic app-media follows whole-app placement
placement.update: New release_id retains data_id; data rollback is not implied by code rollback
placement.move: Quiesce private writers; verify copied package, durable data and fixed app-media; atomically commit all targets in the control store; retain old copies until leases drain; old user-media copies require ownership-aware or explicit cleanup
placement.uninstall: Remove managed package/data/cache by default, optional explicit keep-data; never delete granted or shared media

fat_image_backend.filesystem: LittleFS2 via bounded block callbacks over preallocated FAT files
fat_image_backend.budget: 1152 bytes of base LittleFS cache per active image and 512 per open file, plus structs, queues, fd, outer FAT buffers, I/O workspaces and stacks; measured total required
fat_image_backend.allocation: Lazy, explicitly reserved, physically allocated and flushed before use; no sparse-file assumption
grow: reserve and allocate backing-file tail in erase state
sync and remount to verify superblock
fat_image_backend.bounds: Validated backing length always bounds block callbacks; superblock larger than backing file is an error; unused tail may be recoverable reservation
fat_image_backend.grow_failure: Discard failed in-memory capacity and remount before further access
fat_image_backend.durability_limit: Inner LittleFS recovery does not guarantee intact outer FAT metadata, controller persistence or undamaged media

protection.comparison: Volume-root anchored, component-aware, using native case and alias equivalence; reject unsafe aliases if canonical resolution unavailable
protection.host_maintenance_access: Dedicated management authority and bounded upload leases only

qualification_gates: Boot, font loading, app launch and persistent save on a board with no Flash file partition
No-card, corrupt-card, unknown-layout and removed-system-volume recovery without external fonts
Old private FS naming, replace, quota and KV isolation preserved
Fault injection across allocation, growth, package preparation, control commit, move, resource switch and GC
No partial code/data placement commit; no empty internal fallback saves
Protected directory and FAT alias isolation through all ordinary file entry points
Bounded measured RAM, cold boot, read/write tail latency, actual presentation FPS and audio underruns
integrity_policy: Existing install-time verification only; no new runtime full-content hash scans
current_firmware: Internal pxa-state and font root remain in use; fixed app-media and optional granted read-only SD access are implemented; whole-app backend and removable-system bootstrap are not

default_resource_access.scope: verified app identity and explicit Host storage placement
default_resource_access.current_gamekit_policy: Board explicitly selects registered SD mount; no fallback to enumeration order
default_resource_access.future_policy: PlacementSnapshot supplies selected app media volume
default_resource_access.arbitrary_import: Optional trusted picker only when user explicitly imports another directory
